blocking.fix: Point those importers at ./grants.js. In api.spec.ts, import the grant names from ./grants.js and keep every assertion. Delete the `export { ... } from './grants.js'` line. Take fetchOwnGrants out of the admin/ api column in docs/analysis-and-design/class-model.md.

nonBlocking: Step D: warmRoutes() now runs inside setup(), so the first test in each file spends its own 5 s timeout importing every route chunk. Before, router.ts did this at module load, outside any test timeout. Solo runs: 4/4 pass. With three vitest processes at once, HEAD had 4-6 timeouts per run, always the first heavy test in a file. The base also timed out on the CurriculumAdmin first test under the same load (partial runs, cold cache), so this is not proven to be a regression. Suggestion: call warmRoutes from a beforeAll (setupFile or helper module) so it runs outside the test timeout.
Specs that call createAppRouter directly (router.spec, nav.spec, GuidesView.spec, GuideView.spec, the browser specs) no longer warm route chunks. They pass today.
ModalDialog.vue: withDefaults({ busy: undefined }) makes busy a subtle three-state prop. It is correct, and the 'has no status line for a dialog that is never busy' spec covers it.
